reason: The plugin primarily provides agent-facing web search, with additional vision analysis, image capture, and session file staging features documented in the README.

summaries.zh: 提供优先使用 DuckDuckGo 并可回退 Bing 的网络搜索工具，同时支持通过配置的视觉模型分析图片及在会话中暂存文件。
summaries.en: Provides agent-facing web search with DuckDuckGo and Bing fallback, plus image analysis through configured vision models and file staging within sessions.

capabilities: performs web searches through DuckDuckGo with Bing fallback
sends image sources to configured vision-capable models for analysis
reads and writes user-selected files in session workspaces
modifies plugin settings and model input modality declarations
adds conversation input controls and file or image capture flows
